blocks.text: ANGELES CITY, PAMPANGA, Philippines — The North Luzon Expressway (NLEx) Corp. has prepared for a 3 percent to 5 percent rise in the volume of motorists traversing the NLEx, Subic-Clark-Tarlac Expressway (SCTEx) and Mindanao Avenue Connector from Oct. 29 to Nov. 3 during the observance of the feasts of the saints and souls or “Undas.” NLEx Corp. is deploying 1,500 personnel to work on three shifts daily as patrols, toll tellers, emergency response teams, traffic managers, technology support staff and security aides, according to Robin Ignacio, assistant vice president for traffic operations.
